% Checks cases the fix must not break: topcapt and subcaptionlite with
% hyperref and without hypcap, which step a float's counter with
% \H@refstepcounter when hyperref defines it. Each \ref lands in its float,
% not on the section before it.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{topcapt}
\usepackage{subcaptionlite}
\begin{document}
\section{Tables}\label{sec:tab}
\begin{table}[h]
  \centering
  \topcaption{Top table}\label{tab:top}
  \begin{tabular}{c}1\end{tabular}
\end{table}
\section{Figures}
\begin{figure}[h]
  \centering
  \begin{subfigure}{.4\linewidth}\centering\fbox{Left}\subcaption{Left half}\label{fig:a}\end{subfigure}
  \begin{subfigure}{.4\linewidth}\centering\fbox{Right}\subcaption{Right half}\label{fig:b}\end{subfigure}
  \caption{Split figure}\label{fig:split}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
  \centering
  \topcaption{Second table}\label{tab:two}
  \begin{tabular}{c}2\end{tabular}
\end{table}

Ref: \ref{tab:top}; \ref{fig:split}; \ref{tab:two}.

Autoref: \autoref{tab:top}; \autoref{fig:split}; \autoref{tab:two}.

Sub: \ref{fig:a}; \ref{fig:b}.

Section: \ref{sec:tab}.
\end{document}
